title: How Leaving Your Phone in the Kitchen Changes the Man You're Becoming
caption:
A godly man doesn't sleep next to his temptation. He leaves the phone in the kitchen.

The first night nothing feels different, the urge just has to travel further to find you. A week in, your mornings start belonging to you again. Give it long enough and the silence starts saying something back.

Set your mind on things above, not on earthly things. Small trade. Whole different man.
